correctness.rationale: The symbol-frequency constrained entropy E_b(t) has a unique maximizing stationary renewal process. For any invariant μ, first split the all-zero atom a; under inducing on [1], return-label frequencies q have mean (1−a)/t ≤1/t, and Abramov/Kac yield h_μ ≤ tH(q). Nonnegative relative entropy versus p_k∝exp(−λb^k) bounds H(q) by log Z+λ/t, attained only with a=0, independent returns, and m(λ)=1/t. Writing λ=ρb^(−K), the shifted sums give Z=K+Ψ_b(ρ)+O_b(b^(−K)) and λ∑b^k exp(−λb^k)=A_b(ρ)+O_b(b^(−K)), uniformly for ρ∈[1/b,1]. Inverting L=log_b(1/t) produces the displayed log L+(log_b L+Ξ_b(ρ))/L+O_b((log L)^2/L^2). Index shifts establish periodic Ξ; a nonzero Γ(1−2πi/log b) Fourier coefficient makes A nonconstant, and the exact derivative product forces Ξ nonconstant. Any fixed ρ is sampled along λ=ρb^(−K), giving the complete cluster interval. Independent truncated numerical calculations checked b=2,3,5 periodic endpoints only; all infinite conclusions use analytic proof.
